title: Compute-optimal data scaling for neural surrogates via multi-fidelity training
abstract: arXiv:2610.17221v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural surrogates for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are usually trained on synthetic data from numerical simulators. As models grow and scaling laws demand larger datasets, the cost of data generation often outweighs the training cost and becomes the bottleneck in the scaling quest. Unlike data in other domains, however, each PDE sample has a tunable cost that depends on its numerical fidelity, with the resulting cost-accuracy trade-off governed by known convergence rates. We exploit this property by formalizing neural surrogate training as a function of both data quantity and fidelity under a fixed data generation compute budget, treating fidelity as a fine-grained discrete spectrum rather than a binary distinction. Building on this, we show that multi-fidelity training enables Pareto-optimal error scaling against data generation compute. translated_title: 通过多保真度训练实现神经代理模型的计算最优数据扩展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.17221v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：偏微分方程（PDE）的神经代理模型通常使用来自数值模拟器的合成数据进行训练。随着模型规模的增长以及缩放定律对更大数据集的需求，数据生成的成本往往超过训练成本本身，成为模型扩展进程中的瓶颈。然而，与其他领域的数据不同，每个PDE样本都具有一个可调节的成本，该成本取决于其数值保真度，而由此产生的成本-精度权衡由已知的收敛速率所支配。我们利用这一特性，将神经代理模型的训练形式化为在固定数据生成计算预算下、关于数据量与保真度二者的函数，并将保真度视为一个细粒度的离散谱，而非简单的二元区分。在此基础上，我们证明了多保真度训练能够实现相对于数据生成计算量的帕累托最优误差缩放。通过将较低保真度的模拟作为额外的训练信号，在其上进行训练（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文将数值保真度视为细粒度可调的成本维度而非二元选择，提出多保真度训练方法，在固定数据生成计算预算下实现了神经PDE代理模型的帕累托最优误差缩放，从而突破了数据生成成本这一扩展瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper treats numerical fidelity as a fine-grained tunable cost dimension and shows that multi-fidelity training achieves Pareto-optimal error scaling for neural PDE surrogates under a fixed data generation compute budget, breaking through the data generation cost bottleneck in scaling.
